capabilities.userOutcome: A visitor can understand the product, register, receive a usable personal organization, select a tool, and reach the correct commercial next step.

capabilities.userOutcome: Accounts can authenticate, recover access, manage profiles, select organizations, invite members, change bounded roles, and explicitly transfer ownership.

capabilities.providerBoundary: Email delivery fails closed through the shared outbox when provider configuration is absent.
capabilities.billingBoundary: Identity and membership changes do not infer billing state.
capabilities.privacyOrSafetyBoundary: Foreign tenants are non-enumerable and role changes cannot widen OperatorOS authority.

capabilities.userOutcome: An entitled member launches the exact module host, returns to the validated path, and can end local or global sessions.

capabilities.userOutcome: Customers can see exact plans and add-ons, start the correct checkout, settle only through a signed webhook, inspect history, and cancel or reduce access safely.

capabilities.privacyOrSafetyBoundary: Signature verification, mode matching, idempotency, duplicate and out-of-order protection are mandatory.

capabilities.userOutcome: Modules share tenant-safe directory, private attachments, notifications, jobs, webhooks, activity, and audit behavior with durable recovery.

capabilities.privacyOrSafetyBoundary: Tenant predicates, private blob access, scanning state, retry bounds, dead-lettering, and safe audit projection.
